title: Staging Recovery authority binding and genuine signed certification

phases.objective: Bind a deployment-owned, durable and fully typed 14-component Recovery authority graph into explicit local Windows/Docker Staging, expose trusted pre-certification readiness without synthesizing a certificate, and keep Production, Local Connector and external-provider authority fail-closed.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: server root loads ./stagingRecoveryAuthorityBinding.js in injected_non_live mode
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The Staging Recovery composition has all 14 real server-managed authority components, durable and attestation capabilities, typed provenance and an independent readiness evidence root; /admin/recovery/staging/readiness can compute HTTP-200 blocked readiness with authority_graph.ready=true while genuine certification and external evidence remain absent.
steps: Resolve an explicit staging_local_windows_docker runtime and reject Production, unknown or conflicting runtime identities.
Load the deployment-owned binding module from the Staging image with injected_non_live mode only.
Derive deployment identity from the exact image deployment manifest and derive a durable target fingerprint from persistent server-owned target identity.

Construct the complete 14-component Recovery graph with durable filesystem state, approval/ticket authorities, fenced locking, bounded Staging canary execution, same-store ticket verification, immutable receipts and durable ledger.
Expose typed mad4b.recovery-adapter-provenance.v1 for every component and attest durability/attestation capabilities.
Keep /app/data/recovery-readiness independent from /app/data/recovery-ingress and expose a dynamic atomic current-certification pointer without requiring restart.
With no certification pointer, return trusted pre-certification snapshot data but authenticity_verified=false and no stagingCertification.
Evaluate Staging Recovery Admin readiness and require authority_graph.ready=true while certification and external-evidence checks remain blocking.
assertions: No mock, dummy, in-memory or test-double adapter is installed by the deployment-owned Staging module.
The recoveryStore retains the exact injected executionTicketVerifier object and durable claims/reservations are filesystem-backed.
Production and unknown runtimes fail closed before a binding envelope can be returned.
No Local Connector input or connector.mad4b.com dependency enters the authority graph.
No Production deployment, Production mutation, database mutation, provider mutation, DNS mutation, migration apply or ruleset mutation is authorized by Phase A.
A missing certification is represented as blocked readiness, never as a synthetic signed pass.
If a current-certification pointer appears without valid configured signing trust, the existing authority fails closed immediately.

phases.objective: Provide a genuine post-deployment exact-main Staging certification workflow that executes the durable Recovery canary lifecycle, requires the complete negative suite and fresh external evidence, signs outside the app with a dedicated Ed25519 key, atomically promotes only a verified immutable record, and requires public signed-ingress readback before declaring certification complete.

e2e_journeys.actor: Governed Windows Staging Recovery certification workflow
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: On an exact current-main SHA already deployed to local Windows/Docker Staging, a host-only Ed25519 signer certifies the real durable Recovery authority lifecycle and public activation-dev signed-ingress readiness returns ready=true with certification.valid=true and external_evidence.ready=true; Production remains disabled.
steps: Require workflow_dispatch confirmation, exact lowercase source SHA, exact current origin/main and a clean tracked checkout on a self-hosted Windows runner attached to the Staging Docker host.
Read the exact deployment manifest from the running Staging app and bind the host-side certification process to the same bind-mounted recovery-readiness and recovery-ingress roots.
Require the certification private key only on the Windows host and explicitly fail if private certification-key material is present inside the app container.
Require fresh actual ChatGPT registration observation and OAuth browser round-trip observation; collect exact Worker health and direct-origin denial evidence live.

Run durable inspection, finding, immutable plan, server approval, approval verification/reservation, server-issued Ed25519 execution ticket, ticket reservation, idempotency claim, fenced canary execution, same-fence readback, immutable evidence, ticket/approval finalization and lock release using the Phase A adapters.

Run all twenty canonical negative certification cases and fail closed unless every case passes, including approval/ticket cross-binding, replay, idempotency, restart durability, lost fence, unknown outcome, partial reconciliation, readback and artifact/schema drift cases.

Build mad4b.recovery-staging-certification.v1, evaluate it with the canonical evaluator, bind fresh external evidence to the same deployment SHA and durable target fingerprint, and sign the outer mad4b.recovery-readiness-evidence.v1 record with the dedicated external Ed25519 certification key.

Persist the signed record immutably, verify the persisted signature against the Staging public trust anchor, atomically move current-certification, and re-read the promoted evidence through the canonical readiness authority.

Require final public activation-dev.mad4b.com signed-ingress readiness and certification readback to report authority_graph.ready=true, certification.valid=true and external_evidence.ready=true before the workflow reports certified.
assertions: The certification private key is never copied into the app image, app environment, Recovery evidence record, logs or Local Connector state.
The Activation Gateway ingress signing key is not reused as the Recovery certification key.
No GPT/OpenAPI mutation operation is added for certification orchestration; certification runs from the Windows Staging host against the bind-mounted durable authority store.

The canary mutates only the Staging Recovery certification filesystem namespace and attests production_mutation_performed=false, database_mutation_performed=false and provider_mutation_performed=false.
No Production deployment, Production Recovery activation, Hostinger/provider/database/schema/migration/grant, DNS or ruleset mutation is authorized or performed.
No Local Connector or connector.mad4b.com authority is used.
Implementation status does not itself claim live certification; the live workflow must be dispatched on an exact current-main Staging deployment and must pass public signed-ingress readback.

phases.objective: Production Recovery activation and Production mutation remain outside this feature and require a separate governed release and authorization lifecycle.
blockers: This feature is Staging-only and does not grant Production Recovery execution authority.
Production deployment, Hostinger/provider/database mutation, Production trusted-ingress changes and Production activation require separate governance.
